title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-11
lineage: SBD Reel from WB Vault to reel @ 7.5 IPS to reel@ 7.5 IPS to digital domain. Korg MR 1000 at 1 bit 5.6 mhz to 24-96 via Korg software. Taped by: Dan Healy; Transfer By: Matt Smith & Bob Menke; Mastering By: Derek McCabe

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear remastered soundboard capture of a funky, psychedelic 1967 Shrine night with masterful Jerry Garcia guitar work.
ai_review.review: The tape sounds astonishingly clean for a 1967 recording, thanks to careful remastering that lets every nuance shine.  Listeners rave about Jerry’s preternatural playing – his tone and phrasing sound like those of an older master – and describe the show as an awesome, funky, psychedelic night at the Shrine.  No major flaws are noted, making this a must‑listen for fans who enjoy early Dead magic.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are strongly positive (average 4.5★) and highlight both superb remastered soundboard quality and an outstanding performance, especially Jerry’s guitar.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note the recording is ‘cleaner than most old tapes’, praising the skilled remastering that preserves clarity and balance despite the era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A consistently funky, psychedelic set that holds its own even when compared to the previous night’s show; reviewers describe it as an ‘awesome’ and ‘psychedelic night at the Shrine.’

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for a master‑level tone and preternatural playing; described as sounding like a much older guitar virtuoso.
